memories.text:
function: independent in all activities of daily living; manages vegetable stall without assistance.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (normal).
falls: no falls in the last 12 months; gait steady; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 4 regular (amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD).
mood: reports good spirits, enjoys work and family time.
carers: daughter Priya, lives nearby, provides occasional help with shopping.
goal: "I want to keep working at my stall and stay active."

memories.text: ECG: sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm. No ST‑segment changes. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No arrhythmia detected.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to cardiology for evaluation of borderline hypertension and family history of premature coronary disease. Request ECG review and advice on lipid management.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Cardiology opinion: ECG normal, hypertension controlled. Recommend continue current antihypertensives, add low‑dose aspirin 75 mg OD for primary prevention, and repeat lipid panel in 3 months.
